description:
Today, dispatchers that want to feed on_key handlers must hand-build the string-keyed params map ("key" / "ctrl" / "shift" / "alt" / "meta") that html_engine.ex:61 expects. The wire format is documented only by reading the codegen.

Add:

  defmodule Filament.KeyEvent do
    defstruct [:key, modifiers: %Filament.KeyModifiers{}]
  end

Plus either:
  a) Filament.KeyEvent.to_params/1 → string-keyed map, OR
  b) Filament.Core.dispatch_event/5 accepts %KeyEvent{} as params directly and converts internally.

Why: octo_pi_tui2's KeyDispatcher currently dispatches %{key: %OctoPi.TUI.Key{}} — incompatible with the on_key wire. Surfaced during opi-4x0 (tui2 cleanup epic) audit of key handling.

How to apply: callers (octo_pi_tui2, future external integrators) build %KeyEvent{} and dispatch; Filament owns the on_key params shape end-to-end. Down-stream impact: opi-4x0.1 lands much cleaner once this exists.
title: %Filament.KeyEvent{} struct + helper to build the on_key params map
